ValidationRule.description: Validates estimated revenue, address, and timeframe fields.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'In Sales Qualification'), OR(ISBLANK(EstimatedVolumeCoffee__c), ISBLANK(PostalCode), ISBLANK(EstimatedSalesTea__c), ISBLANK( EstimatedSalesHotChocolate__c), ISPICKVAL(Timeframe__c, "")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please check fields: -Est. Revenue: Coffee, Tea, Hot Chocolate -Address (Postal Code) -Timeframe
